source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 5 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] == 5 and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        stack.append((ny,nx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            for y in range(r0 + 1, r1):
                for x in range(c0 + 1, c1):
                    if grid[y][x] == 0:
                        out[y][x] = 2
            if r0 > 0:
                for x in range(c0 + 1, c1):
                    if grid[r0][x] == 0 and any(grid[r0][z] == 5 for z in range(c0, x)) and any(grid[r0][z] == 5 for z in range(x + 1, c1 + 1)):
                        for beam_x in range(x + 1):
                            if grid[r0 - 1][beam_x] == 0:
                                out[r0 - 1][beam_x] = 2
                        break
    return out
'''
